intro_zh: 高点不只是“最大的那个数”。peak at 说的是数值到顶；the largest increase 说的是某一段涨幅最大；the highest growth rate 说的是增长百分比最快——这三件事经常不在同一个位置。低点同理：hit a low of 是数值最低，bottom out 强调跌到底并开始回稳，recover 则接着讲回升。先说清是哪一种“高”和“低”，再选词。
intro_en: The language of high points, low points, and turning points.

expressions.head: peak at
expressions.pattern: peak at + value / peak in + period

examples.en: East sales peaked at 690 in the final quarter of 2025.
examples.zh: 东部销售额在 2025 年最后一个季度达到 690 的峰值。

examples.en: Mobile orders peak at lunchtime, so the kitchen starts prep at eleven.
examples.zh: 手机订单在午餐时段达到高峰，所以厨房十一点就开始备餐。

expressions.contrast_zh: peak 说的是数值最高，不代表涨幅最大；涨幅最大用 the largest increase，增长最快用 the highest growth rate。后面接 at + 数值，或 in + 时间段。

expressions.head: reach a peak of
expressions.pattern: reach a peak of + value / reach a peak in + period

examples.en: Social sales reached a peak of 128 in June.
examples.zh: 社交渠道销售额六月达到 128 的峰值。

examples.en: Gym attendance reaches a peak of about 200 people on weekday evenings.
examples.zh: 工作日晚间，健身房人数最多时达到 200 人左右。

expressions.contrast_zh: 和 peak at 基本同义，但 reach 让“到达”这个动作更明显，适合讲一段走势走到顶点；只陈述某点是最高值、不强调过程时，用 peak at 更简洁。

expressions.head: hit a high of
expressions.pattern: hit a high of + value / hit a high in + period
collocations: hit a high in early February

examples.en: The share price hit a high of 158 in early February.
examples.zh: 股价在二月上旬创下 158 的高点。

examples.en: Train ticket sales hit a high of 2 million on the first day of the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期第一天，火车票销量冲到 200 万张的高点。

expressions.contrast_zh: 比 reach a peak of 口语一些，媒体和汇报里都常见；常和 all-time high 搭配。它说的是价格或数量本身高，不是涨幅大，别和 the biggest gain 混用。

expressions.head: reach its highest point
expressions.pattern: reach its highest point + at + value / in + period
collocations: reach its highest point in the final quarter

examples.en: East sales reached their highest point at 690 in the last quarter.
examples.zh: 东部销售额在最后一个季度达到最高点 690。

examples.en: Energy use reaches its highest point in the evening, when everyone gets home.
examples.zh: 用电量在晚上大家到家时达到最高点。

expressions.contrast_zh: 最直白的说法，强调“最高”这个概念本身，适合在句子里做主语或宾语；peak at 更简洁。sales 这类复数主语记得用 their。

expressions.head: hit a low of
expressions.pattern: hit a low of + value / hit a low in + period
collocations: hit a low in early January

examples.en: The share price hit a low of 116 in early January.
examples.zh: 股价在一月上旬跌至 116 的低点。

examples.en: Customer satisfaction hit a low of 3.1 stars after the delivery problems.
examples.zh: 配送问题之后，顾客满意度跌到 3.1 星的低点。

expressions.contrast_zh: 和 hit a high of 成对；说数值最低，不一定是跌得最狠的一次。跌幅最大用 the largest fall，跌得最快用 the fastest decline。

expressions.head: reach its lowest point
expressions.pattern: reach its lowest point + at + value / in + period
collocations: reach its lowest point in the second quarter

examples.en: North sales reached their lowest point at 255 in the second quarter of 2024.
examples.zh: 北部销售额在 2024 年第二季度降到最低点 255。

examples.en: My energy reaches its lowest point around three in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我下午三点左右精力最差。

expressions.contrast_zh: 与 reach its highest point 对称，最中性；hit a low of 更口语、更有新闻感。低点后面常接回升，所以常和 before 连用。

expressions.head: bottom out
expressions.pattern: bottom out + at + level / bottom out after + period
collocations: bottom out in the second quarter

examples.en: North sales bottomed out at 255 before rising again.
examples.zh: 北部销售额跌到 255 触底，之后重新上升。

examples.en: Rents in the old town bottomed out last winter and have started to climb.
examples.zh: 老城区的房租去年冬天触底，现在开始回升。

expressions.contrast_zh: 强调跌到底并且即将回升，重点在转折，不只是数值低；reach its lowest point 只陈述最低值，不暗示下一步会涨。

expressions.head: recover
expressions.pattern: recover + to + level / recover from + low

examples.en: The share price recovered to 153 after dipping below 150.
examples.zh: 股价跌破 150 之后回升到 153。

examples.en: Foot traffic in the mall recovered after the subway station reopened.
examples.zh: 地铁站重新开放后，商场的客流恢复了。

expressions.contrast_zh: 指的是一段下跌之后的回升，通常还没回到原来的高点；rise 是中性上升，不包含“之前跌过”这层意思。

expressions.head: a record high
expressions.pattern: reach / hit a record high / a record high of + value

examples.en: Social sales hit a record high for the period at 128 in June.
examples.zh: 社交渠道销售额六月创下该时期的最高纪录 128。

examples.en: Housing prices in the city reached a record high last spring.
examples.zh: 这座城市的房价去年春天创下历史新高。

expressions.contrast_zh: record 表示“按现有全部数据看最高”，如果图只覆盖半年，最好说 a record high for the period 或 its highest level in the period，别让人以为这是历史纪录。

expressions.head: a record low
expressions.pattern: reach / hit a record low / a record low of + value

examples.en: The churn rate fell to a record low of 4.0 percent in the final week.
examples.zh: 流失率在最后一周跌到 4.0% 的历史低点。

examples.en: Waiting times at the clinic hit a record low after the new booking system went live.
examples.zh: 新预约系统上线后，诊所的候诊时间创下新低。

expressions.contrast_zh: 和 a record high 对称，用于数据系列里的最低值；只是比两个时间点更低时用 a new low 或 the lowest level，不要随便用 record。
